buildgolem_link.title: BuildGolem Link
buildgolem_link.intro1: Link your account to bring your designs into this world.
buildgolem_link.intro2: You never type your password here: you confirm a code on the website.
buildgolem_link.copied: Code %s copied: paste it on the website if it does not appear by itself.
buildgolem_link.waiting: Waiting for you to confirm it on the website…
buildgolem_link.codehelp: Go to %s with your account and confirm this code:
buildgolem_link.unlinked: Account unlinked. The token stays in BuildGolem Settings until you revoke it.
buildgolem_link.notlinked: You have not linked your account yet: press K or use /buildgolem.
buildgolem_link.nodesigns: You have no designs yet. Create them at buildgolem.dualix.io.
buildgolem_link.gallery.title: Public gallery
buildgolem_link.mine.title: Designs of %s
buildgolem_link.clicktoload: Click to load it with its corner at your feet
buildgolem_link.lookblock: Look at a block to anchor there.
buildgolem_link.auto.tip: Places the next missing block within reach if you carry it (in creative, any block), facing the right way and bottom to top. Walk around the build and it grows.
buildgolem_link.auto.on: Auto-place on: walk near the build with the blocks in your inventory.
buildgolem_link.auto.learned: %s faces the other way: learned for the next ones.
buildgolem_link.build.tip: Places it at once with /fill and /setblock (needs operator permissions or cheats). Only changes what is missing or wrong, and can be undone.
buildgolem_link.build.noperm: Build all needs operator permissions on the server (or a world with cheats on).
buildgolem_link.build.confirm.title: Build with commands?
buildgolem_link.build.confirm.all: %s missing or wrong blocks will be placed with /fill and /setblock. What is already right is not touched and you can undo it.
buildgolem_link.build.confirm.layer: Layer %s will be placed (what is missing or wrong) with /fill and /setblock. You can undo it.
buildgolem_link.build.nothing: Nothing missing in what is shown.
buildgolem_link.filter.off: The hologram shows every block again.
buildgolem_link.materials.title: What is left to place
buildgolem_link.materials.hint: Click a block to show only that one in the hologram
buildgolem_link.materials.total: %s blocks to get · mouse wheel to scroll
buildgolem_link.loaded: %s: %s × %s × %s, %s blocks. Arrows move it, Page Up/Down change layers, K for the rest.
buildgolem_link.missingmods: Mods missing in this instance (their blocks are not shown): %s
buildgolem_link.none: No design is being projected. Press K to pick one.
buildgolem_link.hud.layer: Layer %s/%s · y %s · %s/%s in this layer · %s %% of the design
